name: unlinked.ai
description: AI-powered LinkedIn network search with open-beta browser upload and agent setup at private.unlinked.ai; legacy REST/MCP schemas remain available as reference.

api.availability: Open-beta sign-in, upload, own-network AI search and Agent setup are at https://private.unlinked.ai/login. Legacy REST agent-key creation remains historical reference.

auth.scoping: Resolved server-side to the authenticated user. Accessible data is strictly limited to the caller's own profile and direct connections.

me.description: Authenticated caller's own profile and network counts

search_contacts.description: Semantic search restricted to caller's direct connections

get_profile.description: Read caller's own profile or direct connection's profile

draft_intro.description: Draft a short forwardable intro to a direct connection (read-only)

imports.description: List LinkedIn archive uploads and ingested record counts

mcp.availability: Current hosted Agent setup is in the beta app at https://private.unlinked.ai/login. This stdio package documents the historical legacy server.
mcp.setup: reference only: git clone https://github.com/IdeaFlowCo/unlinked.ai && cd unlinked.ai/mcp-server && npm install && npm run build

private_archive_availability.note: Open-beta upload, own-network AI search and Agent setup are at https://private.unlinked.ai/login while the source contracts remain default-off in this public app. See https://github.com/IdeaFlowCo/unlinked.ai/blob/main/docs/private-noos-staging.md and https://github.com/IdeaFlowCo/unlinked.ai/blob/main/docs/durable-archive-import.md for the staging contracts and release gates; synthetic receipts do not verify a production rollout.

browser_entry.note: The public www app bridges to the separate beta host. Legacy auth/key fields describe historical API schemas.
